verdict.rationale: FFmpeg is a format-conversion tool, so archive handling during a conversion is a fair format-coverage question for it. However, the evidence only covers audio/video containers, codecs, streamcopy and filtergraphs, with no mention of ZIP, 7z or RAR extraction or repacking. Its inputs (files, pipes, network streams, devices) do not include archives.

support.subject: As a power user, archives (ZIP, 7z, RAR) extract and repack as part of a conversion
